author: Kənd Həyatı
description:
A hearty village meat soup and homemade cabbage stuffed with fresh vegetables make the perfect combination for a cool seasonal day 🥩🥬 In this video, we prepare a rich, comforting soup while also preserving stuffed cabbage for the winter months.

The meat soup is slowly cooked until tender and full of deep homemade flavor. At the same time, fresh cabbage leaves are filled with colorful garden vegetables and carefully prepared for winter storage.

This is traditional village cooking and preserving at its best — warm homemade food for today and fresh garden harvest saved for the colder months ahead. Simple ingredients, family traditions, and seasonal preparation bring the comforting flavors of the countryside to the table. 🌿🍲🫙
title: Village Meat Soup & Vegetable Stuffed Cabbage for Winter 🥩🥬
